responses_off_recording.how: fixtures/responses-off-golden.json was written by running the public session over the Responses API, with no schema profile tool, against the unchanged production code of responses_off_base_sha in a git-archive copy of that commit, through a loopback fake on 127.0.0.1 behind the OpenAI-compatible entry; the recorder module was added to a test file of the copy only, and the copy's src/ was diffed against the archive with no difference
responses_off_recording.command: RESPONSES_OFF_OUT=<out> HEAVY_LOCK_CLASS=cargo with-heavy-lock cargo test -j 4 --test stage_responses_off_recorder -- --exact responses_off::records_the_responses_off_golden (the recorder test file is tests/structured_stage_receipts.rs's top-level helpers plus mod responses_off), run twice; the two outputs were byte-identical
responses_off_recording.normalization: the six number keys of the existing off comparison (tests/structured_stage_receipts.rs NORMALIZED_NUMBER_FIELDS: epoch, occurred_at_epoch_ms, duration_ms, elapsed_ms, estimated_prompt_tokens_sent, estimated_stable_prefix_chars) become "<N>" when the value is a number; inside strings the temporary roots become <ROOT>, the loopback URL <LOOPBACK>, times <TIME>, nonces and UUIDs <NONCE-n>/<UUID-n>, 16-hex revisions <REVISION-n>; nothing else, and no reasoning, preamble, argument, strict, call_id, item id, summary, encrypted_content, unknown item, or history value is normalized
